_readme: One place for every affiliate placement. url must point to an existing /go/ page. Edit wording here; never edit the /go/ pages' affiliate URLs or tags.

yubikey.name: YubiKey hardware security keys
yubikey.card_title: Stop stolen passwords from being enough
yubikey.card_text: Hardware security keys (FIDO2) are tied to the real website, so a phishing page cannot use them even if someone hands over a password.
yubikey.kit_line: Phishing-resistant sign-in for email, cloud and exchange accounts

contabo-storage.name: Contabo Object Storage
contabo-storage.card_text: A copy of critical data with a second provider means one compromised account or one regional outage cannot take everything down with it.
contabo-storage.kit_line: Off-site backups at a second provider

contabo-dedicated.name: Contabo dedicated servers
contabo-dedicated.kit_line: A standby server outside your main cloud for failover
contabo-dedicated.card_title: Have somewhere to fail over to
contabo-dedicated.card_text: A standby server outside your main cloud lets critical services keep running when one provider or region goes down.

contabo-vps.name: Contabo VPS
contabo-vps.kit_line: A cheap, disposable Linux box for testing and research

surfshark-id.name: Surfshark Alternative ID
surfshark-id.kit_line: Masked email addresses so one leak does not expose your real inbox

surfshark-vpn.name: Surfshark VPN
surfshark-vpn.card_title: Protect traffic on networks you do not control
surfshark-vpn.card_text: A VPN encrypts your connection on public and shared Wi-Fi, so people on the same network cannot read or tamper with it.
surfshark-vpn.kit_line: Encrypted traffic on public and shared Wi-Fi

encrypted-ssd.name: Hardware-encrypted SSDs
encrypted-ssd.kit_line: An offline, encrypted copy of your most important files
encrypted-ssd.card_text: An encrypted drive that stays unplugged cannot be reached by ransomware or a hijacked cloud account.

ups-backup.name: UPS battery backups
ups-backup.kit_line: Keeps routers and home servers up through short power cuts

firewall.name: Network firewall appliances
firewall.kit_line: Separates lab and smart devices from the rest of your network

gearup.name: GearUP
gearup.kit_line: Routing optimizer for unstable or high-latency connections
gearup.card_text: GearUP routes game and app traffic over alternative network paths, aiming to reduce latency and packet loss on unreliable connections.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.kit_line: AI voice generation for narrating reports, videos and briefings
elevenlabs.card_text: ElevenLabs generates voiceovers and narration from text, in many voices and languages.
